q: Can I choose or change my provider?
a: Yes. Choice and control are central to the NDIS. You can change providers at any time, subject to any notice period in your service agreement.

q: Do I need an NDIS plan before contacting you?
a: No. You can contact us to discuss general information. To use NDIS funding you generally need an active plan with relevant funded supports.

q: Can someone support me in conversations?
a: Yes. You can involve a family member, friend, advocate, nominee, support coordinator or interpreter at any stage.

q: What if I am unhappy with a service?
a: Tell us so we can try to resolve it. You can also contact the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission on 1800 035 544.
